cases.name: nint_minus_1_refused
cases.why: no object in the protocol carries a negative number — money is unsigned piconero, map keys are unsigned, every timestamp is a count. Refusal is the reversible choice: accepting a type later extends the format, while refusing what was once accepted breaks every peer relying on it.
